IncidentBot: Pager: high error rate in prod - multiple services reporting 5xx spike (502/504), alerted at 2017-06-05T02:18:41Z :rotating_light:
Maya (SRE): acknowledging, joining. seeing 10x 5xx on /api/v1/generate across eu-west-1 LB pools.
Jake (oncall): I'm on-call, jumping in. which stack? envoy at the edge?
Maya (SRE): yes edge envoy -> gateway -> runtime pool. spike started ~5m ago after a gateway config rollout.
Ingrid (infra): I rolled a route-weight change 6m ago, reduced weight to pool-b for canary. rolling back now if needed.
Samir (eng-runtime): logs show upstream resets and 504 timeouts from runtime nodes. envoy access log sample: 
```
[2026-03-10T14:10:12Z] "POST /api/v1/generate" 504 - upstream_reset: connection failure to 10.2.45.12:8080
[2026-03-10T14:10:13Z] "POST /api/v1/generate" 502 - upstream_failure: remote closed
```
Maya (SRE): also seeing a retry loop in the LB config - retries are enabled with max_retries=2 on 502/504, and circuit breaker's max_connections set low. looks like partial shard + retries -> amplified failures.
Jake (oncall): customer impact? any org-wide dashboards?
Lia (CS): A number of paying customers reported errors; Support has ~12 tickets so far, escalated ones from enterprise customer "Nimbus" (latency critical).
Maya (SRE): severity=sev2 for now. plan: 1) disable retries at edge 2) increase envoy upstream circuit breaker thresholds 3) rollback recent route-weight change if traffic skew persists.
Ingrid (infra): applying quick patch to disable retries on envoy listener config for prod-eu: 
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap envoy-edge --type json -p '[{"op": "replace", "path": "/data/retry_policy", "value": "disabled"}]'
```
Ingrid (infra): patch applied, reloading envoy config.
IncidentBot: Deploybot: envoy-edge configmap updated by Ingrid. rolling out config reload.
Maya (SRE): watching error rate...
Samir (eng-runtime): runtime pods not overloaded; connection resets appear to be happening during connection pooling - KV cache pressure? also seeing a sudden increase in concurrent upstream connections on a small subset of hosts.
Maya (SRE): run quick query on envoy stats: 
```
curl -s http://envoy-edge-admin/east/stats | egrep "upstream_cx_overflow|rq_5xx" | tail -n 20
```
Maya (SRE): output shows upstream_cx_overflow spiked on cluster runtime-pool-b: dozens of overflows. circuit_breakers: max_connections=50 set via rollout.
Jake (oncall): setting cb to 500 for that cluster temporarily. Ingrid, can you patch cluster config?
Ingrid (infra): applying: 
```
# patch snippet
cluster_configs:
  - name: runtime-pool-b
    circuit_breakers:
      max_connections: 500
      max_pending_requests: 1000
```
kubectl -n infra apply -f envoy-cluster-patch.yaml
```
Ingrid (infra): applied. envoy reloaded new cb.
Maya (SRE): seeing errors drop from 12% -> 3% over the next 60s. latency improved.
Lia (CS): still receiving some error reports from Nimbus; they're in our escalation queue.
Samir (eng-runtime): investigating root cause: route-weight change pushed more traffic to pool-b which had smaller soft limit and old connection pooling settings; with retries on, downstream failures retried -> overload -> 5xx cascade.
Maya (SRE): good summary. immediate mitigations done: retries disabled, cb loosened. next steps: revert route-weight change to previous steady state, run canary for a smaller weight, and audit automation that flips retry_policy during rollouts.
Jake (oncall): initiating route-weight rollback now. Ingrid, please confirm canary rollback action.
Ingrid (infra): rolling back weight to 0.2 for pool-b -> 0.8 fallback to pool-a. patch applied.
IncidentBot: Rolloutbot: route-weight rollback triggered by Ingrid.
Maya (SRE): monitoring... error rate back down to baseline ~0.6% now.
Lia (CS): notified Nimbus with status update: mitigations applied, investigating root cause, expected ETA for full RCA tomorrow EOD. Nimbus replied :thumbsup:.
Samir (eng-runtime): I'll follow up with a config hygiene PR to ensure cluster defaults have sensible cb and pool sizes + a test that simulates retry amplification.
Jake (oncall): handoff: I'm wrapping up for now, handing to Maya to keep monitoring next 2 hours. paging me if it regresses.
Maya (SRE): taking handoff. adding a postmortem checklist: timeline, config diff, customers impacted, and follow-ups (audit retry_policy behavior, increase default cb, add better alert on upstream_cx_overflow).
Maya (SRE): planned continuous tasks: schedule RCA meeting with infra & runtime, include CS for customer comms.
Lia (CS): I'll prepare a consolidated customer impact summary and send to Nimbus + affected list.
Maya (SRE): closing incident channel in 30m if stable. thanks everyone. :tada:
Jake (oncall): thx team.
IncidentBot: Incident annotated as "mitigated" at 2017654399. Postmortem ticket created: INC-2026-0423-001.
